comment: Config-driven anatomical coronary artery spline geometries for 3D visualization. Territory descriptions follow standard clinical cardiac anatomy without reference to clinical dataset indices.

vessels.description: Courses along the anterior interventricular sulcus to the apex. Supplies the anterior myocardial wall of the left ventricle and anterior two-thirds of the interventricular septum.
Travels along the left atrioventricular groove toward the lateral and posterior myocardium. Supplies the posterolateral left ventricular free wall and left atrial tissue.
Descends within the right atrioventricular sulcus around the acute cardiac margin to the posterior crux. Supplies the right ventricle, inferior left ventricular myocardium, and sinus/AV nodes.
